latestVersion.changelog:
Binance ICT Structure Recognizer 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Provides automated ICT structure recognition for SSS tier signals on Binance BTC/ETH event contracts.
- Identifies Order Blocks, Fair Value Gaps, liquidity sweeps, and inducement patterns using only official Binance K-line data.
- Scores ICT elements to filter signals and outputs structured analysis reports following each 10min/30min/1h K-line close.
- Strict data usage boundaries and output format; does not issue trading signals directly.
- Supports manual and automatic triggering for continuous 24/7 operation.
